references.title: DWDS: beinahe
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Adverb; Etymologie under nah: 'beinah(e)'

notes.rationale: in beinahe Jahresfrist, almost a year. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root beinahe alone.
